summary: Envirotech Vehicles (EVTV) filed an 8-K announcing a merger agreement to acquire Azio AI via a merger subsidiary. Each share of Azio AI common stock will be converted into a pro rata portion of 100 million EVTV shares. A $500,000 cash deposit was paid. No dollar price per share or premium is stated. The board recommends the transaction, advised by unnamed advisors. Closing is expected on the third business day after conditions are satisfied. The all-stock consideration and share count suggest a transformative acquisition. Watch for shareholder approval and Nasdaq listing compliance for the enlarged float.
